upstream_provenance.source_context: Native ABI version 2 introduces SharedBuffer Bytes plus sealed state and receipt; Dart ordinary bytes copy once into native allocation, existing spans retain domain/owner, native ffi_submit synchronously clones ownership before asynchronous dispatch. Dart NativeFinalizer/session finalizer, external typed-data view finalizers, Finalizable keep-alive wrappers and weak view cache coordinate lifetimes. DartPort sends native external data with independent receipt handles and releases peers on failed post. SharedBuffer uses unsafe trusted-pointer preconditions; consumer describes ownership architecture, not audited memory safety. No OH ABI compilation, forced-GC/retain-count test or copy/performance measurement. Shared-buffer compatibility with browser/process boundaries explicitly excluded.
